enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn to the right side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Stay lying in bed. Turn over again. Push one foot out from under the blanket. Pull the blanket back over the foot. Turn onto the back. Remain lying in bed with eyes closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Turn off the alarm. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Pull down the trousers. Sit on the toilet. Use the toilet. Stand up. Pull up the trousers. Flush the toilet. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands. Pick up the facial cleanser. Squeeze cleanser into the palm. Rub the cleanser over the face. Rinse the face with water. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Turn off the tap. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, brewing coffee with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread and two eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Put two bread slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Take the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Crack the eggs into a bowl. Beat the eggs with chopsticks. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the egg mixture into the pan. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto a plate. Take the toast out of the toaster. Put the toast on the plate. Pour the boiled water into a cup. Add coffee powder. Stir the coffee with a spoon. Sit down at the table. Eat the eggs and toast. Drink the coffee. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink. Rinse the plate and cup under the tap. Put them on the drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt and trousers. Take off the pajamas. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Take out a pair of socks from the drawer. Put on the socks. Take the shoes from the shoe rack. Put on the shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Pick up the work bag from the chair. Open the bag zipper. Put the laptop into the bag. Put the charger into the bag. Put the notebook and pen into the bag. Put the water bottle into the side pocket. Zip the bag closed. Take the jacket from the hook. Put on the jacket. Pick up the phone from the desk. Put the phone into the jacket pocket. Pick up the work bag. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office on foot and by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the apartment door. Open the door. Step out. Close the door. Walk down the stairs. Push the building entrance door open. Walk along the sidewalk. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step forward as the bus arrives. Board the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Grasp the overhead handrail. Stand near the door. Step aside for other passengers. Get off the bus at the stop. Walk along the sidewalk. Cross the street at the crosswalk. Walk to the office building. Push the entrance door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the office door. Push the office door open.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community program logistics, answering emails, and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Put the work bag on the chair. Sit down. Take the laptop out of the bag. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the email client. Read the new emails. Open the partner organization email. Type a reply. Attach the program schedule file. Click send. Open the logistics spreadsheet. Update the participant counts in the cells. Save the file. Open the calendar. Check the meeting time. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down at the table. Open the notebook. Take notes during the partner meeting. Point at the schedule on the screen. Say to the partner representative, 'Let's confirm the volunteer list by Friday.' Shake hands with the partner representative. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the outreach document. Type the activity list.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Push the chair in. Walk out of the office. Walk along the street. Push the restaurant door open. Walk to the counter. Order a lunch set. Take the phone out. Pay by scanning the code. Take the receipt. Walk to a table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the rice. Pick up food with the chopsticks. Drink the soup from the bowl. Put down the chopsticks. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return counter. Walk out of the restaurant. Walk back along the street. Push the office door open. Walk to the desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: running program sessions, updating participant records, and planning outreach activities
enriched_activities.desc: Open the program session document on the laptop. Press the print button. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed handouts. Walk to the activity room. Arrange the chairs in a circle. Place one handout on each chair. Greet the participants at the door. Start the program session. Speak to the group. Write key points on the whiteboard with a marker. Hand out the feedback forms. Collect the completed forms. Answer participants' questions. End the session. Say goodbye to the participants. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the participant record file. Type the attendance data into the cells. Save the file. Open the outreach plan document. Type the activity list. Pick up the desk phone. Dial the community center number. Say, 'We would like to book the hall for next month.' Write down the confirmed date on the notepad. Hang up the phone. Save the document.

Stand up from the desk. Turn off the laptop. Close the laptop lid. Put the laptop into the work bag. Put the notebook into the bag. Zip the bag. Put on the jacket. Pick up the bag. Push the office door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Push the building entrance door open. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Board the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Sit down on a seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop. Get off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Cross the street at the crosswalk. Walk to the apartment building. Push the entrance door open. Walk up the stairs. Take out the keys. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the apartment door open. Close the door behind.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner together with Member 2 on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Say to Member 2, 'I'll wash the vegetables.' Put the work bag on the chair. Wash both hands at the sink. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the meat. Close the refrigerator door. Put the vegetables on the counter. Rinse the vegetables under the tap. Put the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Hand the knife to Member 2. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Put the meat into the pan. Stir the meat with the spatula. Add the cut vegetables into the pan. Sprinkle salt. Stir the dish. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the dish onto a plate. Hand the plate to Member 2.

Carry the plates to the table. Set the plates on the table. Put the chopsticks beside the plates. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the chopsticks. Pick up rice from the bowl. Eat the rice. Pick up the meat with the chopsticks. Say to Member 2, 'The partner meeting went well today.' Listen to Member 2. Eat the vegetables. Drink the soup from the bowl. Pick up the last piece of food on the plate. Put down the chopsticks. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Lean back on the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading dirty dishes into the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Stack the plates. Carry the plates to the sink. Scrape the leftovers into the trash bin. Rinse the plates under the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Load the plates into the rack. Load the bowls into the rack. Load the cups into the rack. Put the chopsticks into the cutlery basket. Push the lower rack back in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table surface. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Push the chairs back under the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and waiting for Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control from the coffee table. Point the remote at the TV. Press the power button. Put the remote on the table. Turn the head toward the Bedroom 2 door. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Open the message app. Type a message to Member 2. Put the phone on the sofa cushion. Lean back against the sofa backrest. Look at the TV screen.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and chatting with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Watch the TV program. Turn to Member 2. Say, 'How was the gallery schedule today?' Listen to Member 2. Laugh. Pick up the phone. Open the photo album. Show a photo to Member 2. Put the phone down on the table. Press the channel button on the remote. Comment on the TV show. Pick up the cup from the table. Drink water. Put the cup back on the table. Keep watching the TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and catching up on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the phone. Scroll through the news feed with the thumb. Tap a video. Watch the video. Look up at the TV screen. Press the remote to change the channel. Put the remote down. Pick up the phone again. Open the chat app. Type a reply to a friend. Tap send. Put the phone on the armrest. Stretch both arms upward. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Fill a cup with water at the tap. Walk back to the sofa. Sit down. Drink the water.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Press the water heater switch on. Open the shower door. Step into the shower area. Turn on the shower tap. Wet the body under the water. Pick up the body wash. Squeeze the body wash onto the sponge. Rub the body with the sponge. Rinse the body. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the hook. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body. Hang the towel on the hook. Put on the pajamas. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Press the water heater switch off. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing the phone by the desk lamp to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch on. Pick up the book from the desk. Open the book. Read the pages. Turn the page. Turn another page. Put the book down on the desk. Pick up the phone. Press the power button. Open the reading app. Scroll the article with the thumb. Tap the screen. Open the chat app. Read the messages. Put the phone down on the desk. Pick up the book again. Read another page. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up. Push the chair in.

Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Adjust the pillow under the head. Turn to the right side. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Stay lying in bed with eyes closed. Remain asleep.
